from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_HALF_UP

# --- CONSTANTS SECTION ---

# Sec 16(ia) - Standard deduction amounts
STD_DEDUCTION_OLD = Decimal("50000")                  # Sec 16(ia)
STD_DEDUCTION_NEW = Decimal("75000")                  # Sec 115BAC proviso

# Sec 24(b) - Max house property loss deduction against salary (old regime)
MAX_HP_LOSS_OLD = Decimal("200000")                   # Sec 24(b) / Sec 71(3A)

# Sec 80C, 80CCE, 80CCD(1B), 80D - Chapter VI-A limits (old regime)
MAX_80C = Decimal("150000")                           # Sec 80C
MAX_80CCD_1B = Decimal("50000")                       # Sec 80CCD(1B)
MAX_80D_SELF_NORMAL = Decimal("25000")                # Sec 80D(i) normal
MAX_80D_SELF_SENIOR = Decimal("50000")                # Sec 80D(i) senior citizen
MAX_80D_PARENTS_NORMAL = Decimal("25000")             # Sec 80D(ii) normal
MAX_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR = Decimal("50000")             # Sec 80D(ii) senior citizen

# Sec 87A Rebate thresholds and limits
REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_OLD = Decimal("500000")           # Sec 87A (old)
REBATE_MAX_OLD = Decimal("12500")                     # Sec 87A (old)
REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_NEW = Decimal("1200000")          # Sec 87A (new)
REBATE_MAX_NEW = Decimal("60000")                     # Sec 87A (new)

# Surcharge thresholds and rates (Old & New Regime common tiers, max surcharge 25% in new regime)
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS = [
    Decimal("5000000"),    # 50 Lakhs (10%)
    Decimal("10000000"),   # 1 Crore (15%)
    Decimal("20000000"),   # 2 Crores (25%)
    Decimal("50000000"),   # 5 Crores (37% - old regime only)
]
SURCHARGE_RATES_OLD = [
    Decimal("0.10"),
    Decimal("0.15"),
    Decimal("0.25"),
    Decimal("0.37"),
]
SURCHARGE_RATES_NEW = [
    Decimal("0.10"),
    Decimal("0.15"),
    Decimal("0.25"),
    Decimal("0.25"),
]

# Health and Education Cess rate
CESS_RATE = Decimal("0.04")                           # Health and Education Cess

# Income Tax Slabs: list of (lower, upper_or_None, rate)
SLABS_OLD_UNDER_60 = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("250000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("250000"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

SLABS_OLD_60_80 = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("300000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("300000"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

SLABS_OLD_80_PLUS = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

SLABS_NEW = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("400000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("400000"), Decimal("800000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("800000"), Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("1600000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("1600000"), Decimal("2000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("2000000"), Decimal("2400000"), Decimal("0.25")),
    (Decimal("2400000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]


def round_nearest_ten(amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """
    Sec 288A / 288B:
    1. Drop paise (floor to whole rupees using ROUND_FLOOR).
    2. Round to the nearest multiple of ten: last digit >= 5 rounds up, otherwise down.
    """
    whole_rupees = amount.quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_FLOOR)
    last_digit = whole_rupees % Decimal('10')
    if last_digit >= Decimal('5'):
        return whole_rupees + (Decimal('10') - last_digit)
    else:
        return whole_rupees - last_digit


def compute_regime(inp: dict, is_new_regime: bool) -> dict:
    gross_salary = Decimal(str(inp["gross_salary"]))
    age = int(inp["age"])
    hra_received = Decimal(str(inp["hra_received"]))
    basic_plus_da = Decimal(str(inp["basic_plus_da"]))
    rent_paid = Decimal(str(inp["rent_paid"]))
    rent_city_is_metro = bool(inp["rent_city_is_metro"])
    home_loan_interest = Decimal(str(inp["home_loan_interest"]))
    sec_80c = Decimal(str(inp["sec_80c"]))
    sec_80ccd_1b = Decimal(str(inp["sec_80ccd_1b"]))
    health_ins_self = Decimal(str(inp["health_ins_self"]))
    health_ins_parents = Decimal(str(inp["health_ins_parents"]))
    parents_senior = bool(inp["parents_senior"])

    trace = []

    # 1. Salary / Gross Salary
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Gross Salary",
        "amount": str(gross_salary),
        "clause": "Sec 17(1)"
    })

    current_income = gross_salary

    # 2. HRA Exemption (Old regime only)
    hra_exempt = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new_regime and hra_received > 0 and rent_paid > 0:
        ten_pct_salary = basic_plus_da * Decimal("0.10")
        rent_in_excess = rent_paid - ten_pct_salary
        if rent_in_excess > 0:
            percentage = Decimal("0.50") if rent_city_is_metro else Decimal("0.40")
            pct_salary = basic_plus_da * percentage
            hra_exempt = min(hra_received, rent_in_excess, pct_salary)

    if not is_new_regime and hra_exempt > 0:
        current_income -= hra_exempt
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "HRA Exemption",
            "amount": str(-hra_exempt),
            "clause": "Sec 10(13A)"
        })

    # 3. Standard Deduction
    std_ded = STD_DEDUCTION_NEW if is_new_regime else STD_DEDUCTION_OLD
    std_ded = min(std_ded, current_income)
    current_income -= std_ded
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Standard Deduction",
        "amount": str(-std_ded),
        "clause": "Sec 115BAC" if is_new_regime else "Sec 16(ia)"
    })

    # 4. House Property Income / Loss (Self-occupied house interest, old regime only)
    hp_loss = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new_regime and home_loan_interest > 0:
        hp_loss = min(home_loan_interest, MAX_HP_LOSS_OLD)
        current_income -= hp_loss
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Loss from self-occupied house property set off",
            "amount": str(-hp_loss),
            "clause": "Sec 24(b) and Sec 71(3A)"
        })

    # Ensure Gross Total Income cannot be negative
    if current_income < 0:
        current_income = Decimal("0")

    gti = current_income

    # 5. Chapter VI-A Deductions (Old regime only)
    total_deductions = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new_regime:
        # Sec 80C capped at MAX_80C
        ded_80c = min(sec_80c, MAX_80C)
        if ded_80c > 0:
            total_deductions += ded_80c
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Sec 80C",
                "amount": str(-ded_80c),
                "clause": "Sec 80C"
            })

        # Sec 80CCD(1B) capped at MAX_80CCD_1B
        ded_80ccd = min(sec_80ccd_1b, MAX_80CCD_1B)
        if ded_80ccd > 0:
            total_deductions += ded_80ccd
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Sec 80CCD(1B)",
                "amount": str(-ded_80ccd),
                "clause": "Sec 80CCD(1B)"
            })

        # Sec 80D Health Insurance
        limit_self = MAX_80D_SELF_SENIOR if (age >= 60) else MAX_80D_SELF_NORMAL
        ded_self = min(health_ins_self, limit_self)
        limit_parents = MAX_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR if parents_senior else MAX_80D_PARENTS_NORMAL
        ded_parents = min(health_ins_parents, limit_parents)
        ded_80d = ded_self + ded_parents
        if ded_80d > 0:
            total_deductions += ded_80d
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Sec 80D",
                "amount": str(-ded_80d),
                "clause": "Sec 80D"
            })

        # Sec 80A(2) Overall cap on Chapter VI-A deductions cannot exceed GTI
        if total_deductions > gti:
            excess_ded = total_deductions - gti
            total_deductions = gti
            # Adjust trace or keep track. To keep trace exact sum equal to total_income,
            # we can add a balancing line if needed, but normally GTI is just reduced by total_deductions.
            # Let's cleanly adjust total_deductions to GTI and record net effect.
            # Simpler: cap total deductions at GTI directly.
            pass
        
        # Re-evaluate total deductions capped at GTI
        if total_deductions > gti:
            # Rebuild trace items for Chapter VI-A proportionally or simply adjust the last one,
            # but to ensure exact sum, let's just cap total_deductions beforehand:
            pass

    # Properly apply Chapter VI-A cap per Sec 80A(2)
    if not is_new_regime:
        raw_chapter_vi_a = min(sec_80c, MAX_80C) + min(sec_80ccd_1b, MAX_80CCD_1B) + min(health_ins_self, MAX_80D_SELF_SENIOR if (age >= 60) else MAX_80D_SELF_NORMAL) + min(health_ins_parents, MAX_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR if parents_senior else MAX_80D_PARENTS_NORMAL)
        if raw_chapter_vi_a > gti:
            # If total raw deductions exceed GTI, we need to scale back or cap. 
            # Standard approach: deductions cannot exceed GTI. Let's recalculate individual items if needed, 
            # or cap total_deductions at GTI. Let's trace the exact capped amount.
            allowed_deductions = min(raw_chapter_vi_a, gti)
            # Re-create trace lines for Chapter VI-A accurately reflecting the capped total if necessary,
            # or since we trace individual components above, let's make sure sum(income amounts) == total_income.
            # Let's compute individual allowed deductions cleanly:
            pass

    # Let's write the Chapter VI-A deduction block robustly:
    chapter_vi_a_allowed = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new_regime:
        item_80c = min(sec_80c, MAX_80C)
        item_80ccd = min(sec_80ccd_1b, MAX_80CCD_1B)
        limit_self = MAX_80D_SELF_SENIOR if (age >= 60) else MAX_80D_SELF_NORMAL
        item_80d_self = min(health_ins_self, limit_self)
        limit_parents = MAX_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR if parents_senior else MAX_80D_PARENTS_NORMAL
        item_80d_parents = min(health_ins_parents, limit_parents)
        item_80d = item_80d_self + item_80d_parents

        sum_ded = item_80c + item_80ccd + item_80d
        allowed_sum = min(sum_ded, gti)

        if sum_ded > 0:
            # Proportionally or sequentially allocate allowed_sum
            # Usually Sec 80C first, then 80CCD(1B), then 80D
            rem = allowed_sum
            all_80c = min(item_80c, rem)
            rem -= all_80c
            all_80ccd = min(item_80ccd, rem)
            rem -= all_80ccd
            all_80d = min(item_80d, rem)

            if all_80c > 0:
                trace.append({"kind": "income", "description": "Deduction under Sec 80C", "amount": str(-all_80c), "clause": "Sec 80C"})
            if all_80ccd > 0:
                trace.append({"kind": "income", "description": "Deduction under Sec 80CCD(1B)", "amount": str(-all_80ccd), "clause": "Sec 80CCD(1B)"})
            if all_80d > 0:
                trace.append({"kind": "income", "description": "Deduction under Sec 80D", "amount": str(-all_80d), "clause": "Sec 80D"})
            
            chapter_vi_a_allowed = allowed_sum

    unrounded_total_income = gti - chapter_vi_a_allowed
    if unrounded_total_income < 0:
        unrounded_total_income = Decimal("0")

    # 6. Sec 288A - Rounding of total income
    rounded_total_income = round_nearest_ten(unrounded_total_income)
    income_rounding_adjustment = rounded_total_income - unrounded_total_income
    if income_rounding_adjustment != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Rounding adjustment to total income",
            "amount": str(income_rounding_adjustment),
            "clause": "Sec 288A"
        })

    total_income = rounded_total_income

    # 7. Tax Slabs Computation
    if is_new_regime:
        slabs = SLABS_NEW
    else:
        if age >= 80:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_80_PLUS
        elif age >= 60:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_60_80
        else:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_UNDER_60

    unrounded_tax = Decimal("0")
    for lower, upper, rate in slabs:
        if total_income <= lower:
            break
        upper_bound = upper if upper is not None else total_income
        taxable_in_slab = min(total_income, upper_bound) - lower
        if taxable_in_slab > 0:
            slab_tax = taxable_in_slab * rate
            unrounded_tax += slab_tax
            trace.append({
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": f"Income-tax at {int(rate * 100)}% on slab",
                "amount": str(slab_tax),
                "clause": "First Schedule, Part III, Para A" if not is_new_regime else "Sec 115BAC(1A)(iii)"
            })

    # 8. Sec 87A Rebate & Marginal Relief
    rebate = Decimal("0")
    if is_new_regime:
        if total_income <= REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_NEW:
            rebate = min(unrounded_tax, REBATE_MAX_NEW)
        else:
            # Marginal relief for new regime Sec 87A
            # where total income exceeds 12,00,000 and tax exceeds (total income - 12,00,000)
            excess_income = total_income - REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_NEW
            if unrounded_tax > excess_income:
                rebate = unrounded_tax - excess_income
                if rebate > unrounded_tax:
                    rebate = unrounded_tax
    else:
        if total_income <= REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_OLD:
            rebate = min(unrounded_tax, REBATE_MAX_OLD)

    tax_after_rebate = unrounded_tax - rebate
    if rebate > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rebate under Sec 87A",
            "amount": str(-rebate),
            "clause": "Sec 87A"
        })

    # 9. Surcharge and Surcharge Marginal Relief
    surcharge_rate = Decimal("0")
    thresholds = SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS
    rates = SURCHARGE_RATES_NEW if is_new_regime else SURCHARGE_RATES_OLD

    for t, r in zip(thresholds, rates):
        if total_income > t:
            surcharge_rate = r

    surcharge = tax_after_rebate * surcharge_rate

    # Surcharge Marginal Relief computation
    surcharge_marginal_relief = Decimal("0")
    if surcharge_rate > 0:
        # Find applicable threshold exceeded
        active_threshold = Decimal("0")
        active_rate = Decimal("0")
        prev_threshold = Decimal("0")
        prev_rate = Decimal("0")
        for t, r in zip(thresholds, rates):
            if total_income > t:
                active_threshold = t
                active_rate = r
            else:
                break

        # Tax + Surcharge at total_income
        tax_plus_surcharge_actual = tax_after_rebate + surcharge

        # Tax + Surcharge at threshold
        # Compute tax at threshold
        tax_at_threshold = Decimal("0")
        for lower, upper, rate in slabs:
            if active_threshold <= lower:
                break
            upper_bound = upper if upper is not None else active_threshold
            taxable_in_slab = min(active_threshold, upper_bound) - lower
            if taxable_in_slab > 0:
                tax_at_threshold += taxable_in_slab * rate
        
        # Rebate at threshold (if any, though threshold >= 50L so no rebate)
        surcharge_at_threshold = tax_at_threshold * active_rate
        total_at_threshold = tax_at_threshold + surcharge_at_threshold

        max_allowed = total_at_threshold + (total_income - active_threshold)
        if tax_plus_surcharge_actual > max_allowed:
            surcharge_marginal_relief = tax_plus_surcharge_actual - max_allowed

    if surcharge > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Surcharge",
            "amount": str(surcharge),
            "clause": "First Schedule"
        })

    if surcharge_marginal_relief > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Surcharge marginal relief",
            "amount": str(-surcharge_marginal_relief),
            "clause": "First Schedule / Marginal Relief"
        })

    tax_plus_surcharge_net = tax_after_rebate + surcharge - surcharge_marginal_relief

    # 10. Health and Education Cess
    cess = tax_plus_surcharge_net * CESS_RATE
    if cess > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Health and Education Cess",
            "amount": str(cess),
            "clause": "Finance Act"
        })

    unrounded_final_tax = tax_plus_surcharge_net + cess

    # 11. Sec 288B - Rounding of Tax Payable
    rounded_final_tax = round_nearest_ten(unrounded_final_tax)
    tax_rounding_adjustment = rounded_final_tax - unrounded_final_tax
    if tax_rounding_adjustment != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rounding adjustment to tax payable",
            "amount": str(tax_rounding_adjustment),
            "clause": "Sec 288B"
        })

    tax_payable = rounded_final_tax

    return {
        "total_income": int(total_income),
        "tax_payable": int(tax_payable),
        "trace": trace
    }


def compute(inp: dict) -> dict:
    old_result = compute_regime(inp, is_new_regime=False)
    new_result = compute_regime(inp, is_new_regime=True)
    return {
        "old": old_result,
        "new": new_result
    }
